label: Cough
note: First authored flow, from the original handoff. Its original emergency_gate entries are all covered by the universal gate (severe breathlessness, crushing chest pain, significant haemoptysis, cyanosis, cannot speak in full sentences, choking) and its red_flag_review entries by the universal 'urgent' flags, so they are not duplicated here.

slots.about: how many days or weeks the cough has been going on
slots.ask: How many days or weeks have you had the cough?

slots.about: whether the cough is dry or brings up phlegm
slots.ask: Is it a dry cough, or are you bringing up phlegm?

slots.about: the colour of the phlegm, and whether there has been any blood in it
slots.ask: What colour is the phlegm, and have you seen any blood in it?

slots.about: whether it is worse at night, when lying down, or with exercise
slots.ask: Is it worse at any particular time, or in any position?

slots.about: whether they have a fever or feel hot and shivery
slots.ask: Do you have a fever, or feel hot and shivery?

slots.about: whether they feel short of breath at all, and when
slots.ask: Do you feel short of breath at all? If so, when?

slots.about: chest pain, wheeze, unintended weight loss, night sweats, or heartburn
slots.ask: Has anything else come with it — fever, vomiting, weight loss, anything?

background.about: whether they smoke or used to, and roughly how much
background.ask: Do you smoke, or did you used to? Roughly how much?

background.about: known asthma, COPD, heart conditions, or other ongoing illnesses
background.ask: Do you have any ongoing or past medical conditions?
Are you taking any regular medicines?
Do you have any drug allergies?

clinician_note_rules.note: Patient is on an ACE inhibitor. Consider drug-induced cough.
Patient reports blood in sputum. TB and malignancy warrant consideration.
Chronic cough (over 8 weeks). TB, malignancy, asthma, reflux and ACE inhibitor use warrant consideration.
Cough over three weeks. Consider chest imaging and TB screening per local protocol.

rules.reason: acute cough with no red flags
